facts.text: A braking intervention creates hazards that a warning system never had, including braking on a grade, braking with a raised or suspended load, rear-end impacts from following machines, and operator jolts.
facts.quote: a braking intervention creates hazards the warning system never had.** These include braking on a grade, braking with a raised or suspended load, rear-end impacts from following machines and operator jolts.

facts.text: Komatsu's wheel loader documentation, on an undated page accessed in 2026, warns that the machine may stop abruptly and become unstable.
facts.quote: Komatsu's wheel loader documentation (undated page, accessed 2026) warns the machine "may stop abruptly and become unstable"

facts.text: Komatsu's wheel loader documentation, on an undated page accessed in 2026, tells users to turn off stop control during trailer loading, on steep slopes, on slippery or soft ground, and with suspended loads.
facts.quote: tells users to turn off stop control during trailer loading, on steep slopes, on slippery or soft ground and with suspended loads.

facts.text: Addressing the hazards created by braking intervention calls for a new hazard and risk analysis for the intervention, rating false-activation hazards separately from missed-detection hazards.
facts.quote: a new hazard and risk analysis for the intervention, with false-activation hazards rated separately from missed-detection hazards

facts.text: Addressing the hazards created by braking intervention calls for physical confirmation of the highest-consequence or weakest-model claims.
facts.quote: physical confirmation of the highest-consequence or weakest-model claims.

facts.text: The safety engineer should approve the braking-intervention project's evidence strategy before the project accumulates millions of virtual results.
facts.quote: The safety engineer should approve the evidence strategy before the project accumulates millions of virtual results.
